'''Bryce Agoris''' was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] within the [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrator]] branch. Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Agoris deserted and, along with his friend and freelance [[operative]] [[Myrgaanti Shi-Iki]], stole the [[VGK-3 Shooting Star class starfighter]] prototype which they named the ''[[Warhog]]''.
